AllProfessions.dc.html: 45 regulated professions and compulsory trades in Ontario. Not listed? Most jobs don't need a licence — but check Ontario's full list.
Source: Ontario.ca "Work in your profession or trade" and each regulator. Requirements change — every pathway links its regulator.
PathwayDentalHygienist.dc.html: Regulator: the College of Dental Hygienists of Ontario (CDHO). Steps follow the regulator's own pages — Settle never applies for you or decides if you qualify.
You can't work as a dental hygienist in Ontario until the College of Dental Hygienists of Ontario (CDHO) registers you.
If you trained in another language
Read CDHO's requirements for internationally educated dental hygienists.
CDHO assesses whether your education is substantially equivalent.
Pass the national exam from the National Dental Hygiene Certification Board (NDHCB).
Show language proficiency, good character and liability insurance.
Free licensing guidance for internationally trained health professionals

Official source · the College of Dental Hygienists of Ontario (CDHO)

PathwayRefrigeration.dc.html: Pathway: Refrigeration and air conditioning mechanic
Refrigeration and air conditioning mechanic: your licensing pathway
Regulator: Skilled Trades Ontario. Steps follow the regulator's own pages — Settle never applies for you or decides if you qualify.
You can't work as a refrigeration and air conditioning mechanic in Ontario without a Certificate of Qualification from Skilled Trades Ontario.
Proof of your hours and experience
Check that this is a compulsory trade — you need a certificate to work in it in Ontario.
